name: Galleonosaurus
sum: A small basal ornithopod from the Early Cretaceous Wonthaggi Formation of Victoria, Australia, named for the galleon shape of its upper jaw.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: NMV P229196, a complete left maxilla with partial dentition, from Flat Rocks, Wonthaggi Formation, Victoria.
material: Several other Flat Rocks specimens, collected from 2008 on.
biology: A small herbivorous ornithopod; its biology is not described in the sources consulted.
author: Herne et al. 2019
